or001.e: 学校 (がっこう): school. 字 and 枚 look like 学 and 校.
or001.t: My older brother is a school teacher.

or002.e: 電車 (でんしゃ): train. 雷 (thunder) and 東 (east) are visual traps.

or003.t: There is a cat on the desk.

or004.t: There is a bag under the bed.

or005.e: 右 (みぎ): right. 左 is left; 石 (stone) looks similar.

or006.t: The bank is to the left of the supermarket.

or009.t: I'll wait in front of the station.

or010.t: There is a park to the north of my house.

or011.t: I want to go to a southern country.

or012.e: 東 (ひがし): east. 束 looks very similar.
or012.t: The sun rises in the east.

or013.t: I can see a mountain to the west of the window.

or018.e: 水 (みず): water. 氷 is ice.
or018.t: I want to drink some water.

or019.t: The weather is bad, isn't it?

or020.t: The light in the room won't turn on.

or021.e: 電話 (でんわ): telephone. 語 looks like 話.

or023.e: 人 (ひと): person. 入 (enter) is the classic trap.

or024.e: 入って (はいって): to enter.

or025.e: 大きい (おおきい): big. 犬 (dog) and 太 look similar.

or026.e: 小さい (ちいさい): small. 少 means "few, a little".

or028.t: My younger sister has long hair.

or029.e: 白い (しろい): white. 百 and 自 look similar.

or030.e: 新しい (あたらしい): new. Watch the okurigana: it is not 新らしい.

or033.e: 見ます (みます): to see, watch. 貝 (shellfish) is very similar.

or034.e: 聞きます (ききます): to listen. 間, 開 and 閉 share the same "gate" 門.

or035.e: 書きます (かきます): to write.

or036.e: 読みます (よみます): to read.

or037.e: 話します (はなします): to talk.

or038.e: 食べます (たべます): to eat. Note べ (hiragana) vs. ベ (katakana).

or039.e: 飲みます (のみます): to drink.

or040.e: 買います (かいます): to buy.
or040.t: I bought shoes at the department store.

or041.e: 来ます (きます): to come.

or042.e: 行きます (いきます): to go.
or042.t: I'm going to the sea on Sunday.

or043.e: 出ます (でます): to leave.

or044.e: 休みます (やすみます): to rest. 体 (body) is the classic trap.
or044.t: We're tired, so let's take a rest.

or046.t: I asked the teacher a question.

or049.t: My father is an office worker.

or050.e: 母 (はは): my mother. 毎 contains 母.
or050.t: I went shopping with my mother.

or051.t: I wrote a letter to a friend.

or054.e: 子ども (こども): children. 了 and 予 look similar.

or055.e: 毎日 (まいにち): every day.

or056.e: 今 (いま): now. 令 is almost identical.

or057.e: 今年 (ことし): this year. 午 looks like 年.
or057.t: I'm going to Japan this year.

or058.e: 来年 (らいねん): next year.

or059.e: 午後 (ごご): afternoon. 牛 (cow) looks like 午.
or059.t: It will rain from the afternoon.

or062.e: 千 (せん): one thousand. 干 is almost identical.

or063.e: 百 (ひゃく): one hundred. 白 (white) differs by just one stroke.

or064.e: 一万 (いちまん): ten thousand. 方 and 力 look similar.

or067.e: 九つ (ここのつ): nine (things). 丸 (round) is very similar.

or069.e: 八 (はち): eight. ハ is katakana.
or069.t: I'm going on a trip in August.

or071.t: The flame is strong, so be careful.

or072.e: お金 (おかね): money. 全 looks similar.

or073.e: 土 (つち): soil, earth. 士 has a shorter bottom stroke.
or073.t: There are bugs in the soil.

or075.t: I'm going back to my country.

or076.e: 外国 (がいこく): foreign country, abroad.

or077.e: 何 (なに): what. 伺 is very similar.

or078.e: 時間 (じかん): time. 問 (question) looks like 間.

or079.t: Please go home ahead of me.

or080.t: I take my medicine after meals.

or083.e: 手 (て): hand. 毛 (hair) looks similar.

or084.t: You have long legs, don't you?

or085.e: 口 (くち): mouth. ロ is katakana.

or086.t: There are no clouds in the sky.

or087.e: 多い (おおい): many. Careful: not 大い.
or087.t: There are a lot of people today, aren't there?

or088.e: 少し (すこし): a little. 小 means "small".
or088.t: Please put in a little sugar.

or089.e: 立って (たって): to stand.

or090.e: 言って (いって): to say.

or094.t: Please go straight along this road.

or095.e: 来週 (らいしゅう): next week.

or097.e: 七時 (しちじ): seven o'clock. 持 and 侍 look like 時.
or097.t: I get home at seven every evening.

or098.e: 半分 (はんぶん): half. 公 looks like 分.
or098.t: I ate half of my lunch.

or099.t: What is that tall building over there?

or101.e: テレビ: television. ビ with two dots, not ピ.

or102.e: コーヒー: coffee. It has two long vowels.

or103.e: レストラン: restaurant. ン and ソ are easy to confuse.
or103.t: I had dinner at a restaurant.

or104.e: パン: bread. パ has a small circle.

or105.e: シャツ: shirt. Small ャ; シ and ツ are different.

or107.t: Please write it in your notebook.

or108.t: I buy vegetables at the supermarket.

or110.t: My older brother is good at the guitar.

or113.t: I take the elevator to the 5th floor.

or115.e: パーティー: party. ティ with a small ィ.
or115.t: Would you like to go to the party?

or118.t: Please put it on the table.

or120.e: ナイフ: knife. ナ and メ are easy to confuse.
or120.t: Please cut it with a knife.

or121.t: I'm going on a trip in May.

or124.e: 十人 (じゅうにん): ten people.

or125.e: 三千 (さんぜん): three thousand.

or126.e: 百円 (ひゃくえん): a hundred yen.

or127.e: 先月 (せんげつ): last month.

or128.e: 来月 (らいげつ): next month.
or128.t: I'm going back to my country next month.

or129.e: 今月 (こんげつ): this month.

or130.e: 毎月 (まいつき): every month.
or130.t: I call my family every month.

or131.e: 毎週 (まいしゅう): every week.

or133.e: 入口 (いりぐち): entrance. 人口 means "population".

or135.e: 東口 (ひがしぐち): east exit.
or135.t: Let's meet at the east exit.

or136.e: 西口 (にしぐち): west exit.
or136.t: Please go out through the west exit.

or137.e: 北口 (きたぐち): north exit.

or138.e: 高校 (こうこう): high school.
or138.t: I met a friend from high school.

or139.e: 中学校 (ちゅうがっこう): junior high school.
or139.t: The junior high school is near my house.

or140.e: 男の子 (おとこのこ): boy.
or140.t: Who is that boy over there?

or144.e: 新しい (あたらしい): new.

or145.t: I threw away some old books.

or146.t: Do you know a cheap shop?

or147.e: 話します (はなします): to speak.

or148.e: 聞こえません (きこえません): can't be heard.

or149.e: 左手 (ひだりて): left hand.
or149.t: I hold the pen in my left hand.

or150.e: バス: bus. パス (pass) is a different word.
or150.t: I go to school by bus.
